details:
I notice when I open my Social tab or my Group tab in the VRChat menu, my game freezes for between 1-3 seconds and all images and information load at once.

I propose a change that would look like the menu+UI opening immediately with less lag and the information loading in slowly and sequentially as opposed to "all at once". This would look like the friends and images loading in one-at-a-time from the top of the menu and going down the menu as you scroll down it.

I would prefer waiting a second or a few seconds for information and images to populate than losing all of my frames and experiencing a total game freeze from opening these menus.

For context, I am on PCVR and I have an imperfect wifi connection using Virtual Desktop and a CPU that is not ideal for VRChat (Ryzen 5 3500X) and a 10gb 3080 GPU. I am also often in busy instances using most of my VRAM and CPU. 

I also have an overlay running, the SlimeVR server, and sometimes other programs.

I also have a LOT of friends online during weekends (in the order of hundreds) and I am in nearly the maximum amount of groups leading to a lot of data needing to be populated in these menus.
title: Reducing Group tab menu and Social tab menu lag
